name: Proving Allegiance
summary: Gunther Arcanus tests whether you serve the free-willed Forsaken or the Lich King. To earn his trust, you are sent to summon and destroy Lillith Nefara, a Scourge operative near his island.

sections.title: A Recluse's Suspicions
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus has kept to an island in Brightwater Lake since rising into undeath. He fiercely guards his freedom. Bethor Iceshard's enchantments on Gunther's spellbook showed that the emissary carries no Scourge taint. Still, words and charms cannot quiet the hermit's suspicions. An outsider must prove hostility toward the Lich King's minions through decisive violence before Gunther will trust them.

sections.title: The Slaying of Lillith Nefara
sections.body: South of Gunther's refuge, a bloodstained ritual altar marks the place where Lillith Nefara operates in the Tirisfal Glades. She is a formidable agent of the Scourge. A Candle of Beckoning awakens her from the shadows, bringing her into open combat. Her defeat breaks Gunther's long-held belief that he alone among the undead had escaped the Lich King's control.

faq.q: Why does Gunther Arcanus need proof?
faq.answer: Gunther has survived as an independent undead by trusting no one. With the Scourge, the Scarlet Crusade, and other threats around him in Tirisfal, he suspects any undead visitor may be the Lich King's agent until they shed Scourge blood.
Lillith Nefara is a powerful Scourge agent active along Brightwater Lake's southern shores. She serves the Lich King from an ancient, bloody altar near Gunther's island.

faq.q: What is the Candle of Beckoning?
faq.answer: The Candle of Beckoning is a ritual item taken from a crate on Gunther's island. Place and light it on the bloody altar to summon Lillith Nefara from her resting place and face her in battle.

faq.q: What realization does Gunther come to upon Lillith's defeat?
faq.answer: Lillith's defeat makes Gunther accept that he is not unique. Until then, he believed he was the only undead in Lordaeron to break free from the Lich King's telepathic domination.

faq.q: Where does this confrontation take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place at an altar on the lakeshore just off the southern coast of Gunther's island in Brightwater Lake, in eastern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What happens after proving your allegiance?
faq.answer: Once Gunther's doubts are settled, he agrees to hear the Undercity's emissaries and reconsider his solitary exile, opening the way to his formal recruitment into Lady Sylvanas's Forsaken.

angles.text: For you as Forsaken, breaking Gunther's isolation is personal. It shows a brother in undeath that none of you need face the Scourge or the living alone.
As a mage, you know the arcane and necromantic talents of Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus. Showing your own skill earns the respect of a powerful fellow caster.
